ideas.title: Minnesota Officials' Handling of Welfare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of ignoring fraud warnings and the resulting losses in Minnesota's welfare program.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and examine the management of public funds in Minnesota.
questions: What were the warnings that Minnesota officials ignored?
How much money was lost due to welfare fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has significant implications for Minnesota's government and its handling of public funds.
